quotes.text: I love the taste and texture of this! It's so nice to have a snack like this available that isn't packed with added sugars and ingredients I can hardly pronounce.
Honestly, it's my favorite snack. The overall experience was 10/10. Love Stryve. Love biltong.
Tried others and the meat was low quality with a large percentage of fat and gristle. Not Stryve, though — the slabs are delicious.
